title: AI-Based Malware Classification System
description: Modern malware variants constantly change their signatures to evade traditional antivirus systems. AI-based malware classification systems can analyze behavioral patterns, file structures, and execution traces to identify malicious software.
challenges: Reducing false positives while maintaining detection accuracy

title: AI-Based Document Forgery Detection
description: Fraudsters manipulate digital documents such as ID cards, certificates, and invoices. AI-based systems can analyze image inconsistencies, text anomalies, and metadata to detect forged documents using computer vision, pattern recognition, and machine learning techniques.
challenges: Detecting subtle manipulations in scanned documents
Handling multiple document formats and layouts
Ensuring high detection accuracy for real-world use cases

title: AI-Based Insider Threat Detection
description: Insider threats are difficult to detect because malicious activities often appear as legitimate system behavior. AI-based systems can analyze user activity logs, access patterns, system behavior, and login histories to identify unusual actions indicating insider threats.
challenges: Identifying abnormal behavior among legitimate users
Analyzing large volumes of user activity logs
Minimizing false alerts while maintaining high detection accuracy

title: AI-Powered Data Privacy Compliance Checker
description: An AI-powered compliance checker can automatically analyze databases, logs, and storage systems to detect exposure of sensitive information, identify policy violations, and ensure adherence to data protection standards such as GDPR.
challenges: Identifying personally identifiable information (PII) in large datasets
Detecting unauthorized access or data leaks
Ensuring compliance without affecting operational efficiency

title: Adversarial Attack Detection for AI Models
description: Machine learning models can be manipulated using adversarial examples—inputs slightly modified but imperceptible to humans that cause incorrect predictions. The system should detect adversarial manipulations before they influence AI decision-making.
challenges: Identifying adversarial inputs with very small perturbations
Ensuring detection works across different AI models
Protecting AI systems without affecting model performance

title: AI Model Integrity Verification
description: AI models deployed in production may be modified or corrupted by attackers. The system uses hashing, digital signatures, or blockchain verification to ensure deployed models match original trusted versions.
challenges: Detecting unauthorized modifications to AI models
Ensuring verification doesn't increase system overhead
Maintaining secure storage of model integrity data

title: Secure Federated Learning Framework
description: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data. The system protects against malicious participants injecting harmful updates or inferring sensitive information from shared parameters.
challenges: Preventing data leakage during distributed training
Detecting malicious or poisoned model updates
Maintaining model accuracy with strong privacy protection

title: Poisoned Dataset Detection
description: Machine learning models rely on training datasets that attackers can poison with manipulated data. The system analyzes datasets to identify and remove suspicious data points before model training.
challenges: Identifying subtle malicious patterns in large datasets
Differentiating legitimate outliers from poisoned data
Maintaining model performance after data removal

title: AI-Powered Multi-Modal Deepfake Detection
description: Deepfake technologies generate realistic fake media for misinformation and fraud. AI system analyzes visual, audio, and metadata signals to detect manipulated media across images, videos, and audio.
challenges: Detecting deepfakes across images, videos, and audio
Identifying subtle inconsistencies like facial expressions
Supporting real-time detection with high accuracy

title: AI-Powered Data Loss Prevention
description: Organizations store sensitive information that AI systems analyze through network traffic, files, and user activity to detect potential data leaks and prevent unauthorized transfers.
challenges: Analyzing large volumes of network and user data
Preventing leaks while minimizing false positives

title: Network-Level Data Exfiltration Detection
description: Attackers steal data gradually to avoid detection. AI-based monitoring analyzes network traffic patterns to identify suspicious data transfer activities indicating exfiltration attempts.
challenges: Detecting slow and stealthy data exfiltration
Analyzing large volumes of network traffic efficiently
Minimizing false positives while maintaining accuracy

title: Hardening C2 Against Synthetic Identity Injection
description: Generative AI enables deepfake audio/video impersonation of officials. Secure system verifies communication authenticity to prevent fraudulent command issuance through synthetic identities.
challenges: Detecting deepfake audio and video in real time

title: AI-Powered Mobile Security Companion
description: AI-based Android app analyzes SMS/messages in real time to detect phishing links, malware URLs, and manipulative language while providing cybersecurity threat information.
challenges: Detecting phishing and social engineering in real time

title: Deepfake Voice/Video Scam Detector
description: Lightweight AI tool analyzes audio/video content to detect AI-generated media by examining speech patterns, audio frequencies, and visual cues indicating synthetic generation.
challenges: Detecting subtle patterns in AI-generated media
Real-time analysis with minimal processing overhead
Building reliable scam profile tracking system

title: Automated Vulnerability Monitoring Tool
description: Web-based tool scans vendor/security websites to collect newly disclosed vulnerabilities, extracting CVE IDs, severity levels, and mitigation steps for organizational tracking.
challenges: Processing large volumes of vulnerability data

title: Unencrypted PII in Browser Storage
description: Web apps store sensitive data in browser storage or debug logs accessible by malicious scripts. System identifies leaked PII and implements secure storage practices.
challenges: Identifying leaked PII categories in logs/storage
Demonstrating XSS exploitation of exposed data
Implementing data redaction and CSP measures

title: Centralized Application Firewall System
description: Application-aware firewall enables administrators to define security policies for domains, IPs, and protocols through centralized dashboard with traffic monitoring.

title: AI-Based Web Application Attack Detection
description: AI-driven system analyzes HTTP requests in real time to detect/block SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF attacks and includes vulnerability scanning for developers.
challenges: Minimizing false positives in attack detection
Handling large volumes of web traffic efficiently

title: Secure Authentication & Session Management
description: Secure framework implements strong authentication, session handling, and monitoring to prevent session hijacking and credential-based attacks on web applications.
challenges: Preventing session hijacking and credential theft

title: Web Application Supply Chain Scanner
description: Analyzes web application dependencies to detect vulnerable third-party libraries and provides remediation recommendations to developers.

title: Secure API Gateway for Web Applications
description: Gateway enforces authentication, rate limiting, request monitoring, and logging to protect APIs from unauthorized access and abuse while maintaining performance.

title: GraphQL Introspection Batching DoS Attack
description: GraphQL introspection enables attackers to craft deeply nested queries/batch operations exhausting server resources. System implements query complexity limits.

title: HTTP Request Smuggling in Reverse Proxies
description: Exploits proxy/backend server parsing inconsistencies in HTTP headers to enable session hijacking, cache poisoning, and security bypass through malformed requests.

title: Digital Intelligence Aggregation Platform
description: OSINT platform combines social media, domain records, public databases into centralized dashboard for username searches, email analysis, and geolocation tracking.
challenges: Building OSINT modules without external APIs
Aggregating data from multiple open sources

title: Early Warning System for Android Ransomware
description: Behavior-based system monitors Android devices for rapid file encryption or screen locking indicative of ransomware, providing real-time user alerts.
challenges: Accurate alerts with low false positives

title: Analysis of Tor Network Hidden Services
description: System identifies active .onion services hosting malicious content and analyzes vulnerabilities while maintaining ethical/legal compliance.

title: Secure DNS Filtering System
description: Real-time DNS filtering detects/blocks malicious domains using threat intelligence and anomaly detection, including DGA domains and DNS tunneling.

title: Centralized Infrastructure Management Platform
description: Single interface for secure monitoring, management, and control of distributed servers, firewalls with role-based access and audit logging.

title: Automated Fuzzing for IoT Protocols
description: Fuzzing framework tests Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee protocols with malformed inputs to identify handshake and state transition vulnerabilities.
challenges: Automatic crash detection and vulnerability ID

title: Dark Web Monitoring Tool

title: Cybersecurity Readiness Assessment Tool
description: Assesses organizational capabilities across prevention, detection, response, recovery generating maturity scores and recommendations.

title: BGP Route Hijack Detection

title: Software-Defined Load Balancer & WAF

challenges: WAF rules for web attack protection

description: Monitoring platform collects performance metrics from VMs/containers, stores in real-time database with visualization dashboards and alerting.

title: Cloud IAM Mismanagement Detection
description: Analyzes IAM configurations identifying overly permissive policies and privilege escalation paths with remediation recommendations.

title: Cloud Satellite Data Processing
description: Scalable cloud platform processes massive satellite/geospatial datasets for researchers with efficient storage, analysis, and visualization.

title: DNS Rebinding Attack Detection
